_comment: TEMPLATE. The app never reads this file. start.cmd copies it to companion/config.json the first time; the exe writes its own config.json beside itself (the folder PKG-MUTANT-SHOP.exe is in). load_config() merges DEFAULT_CONFIG (companion/server.py) with that one file and nothing else, so this mirrors DEFAULT_CONFIG exactly: an unedited copy changes nothing, and deleting a key from config.json falls back to DEFAULT_CONFIG. Forward slashes even on Windows. Keys the app no longer reads (dpi.mode/host/port_v2/port_v1/port_ezremote/auto_reload/live_probe, consoles[].dpi_port) are deliberately absent.
_ps5_ip: Set ps5_ip to the console's address, or leave it: the app discovers a PS5 on the LAN by asking /api/health for on_console:true and writes what it finds.
